question: What is the name of the compound with the formula N₂O₅?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dinitrogen pentoxide**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The compound with the formula **N2O5** is named **Dinitrogen pentoxide**.
 
• **Dinitrogen pentoxide** is a chemical compound consisting of two nitrogen atoms and five oxygen atoms.
 
• It is an anhydride of nitric acid and is used in various chemical reactions and processes.
 
• **N2O5** is a white solid at room temperature and can be used as a reagent in the production of other nitrogen compounds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nitrogen dioxide (NO2)** is a different compound and is a brown gas at room temperature.
 
• **Nitric oxide (NO)** is a colorless gas and plays a role in various biological processes.
 
• **Nitrous oxide (N2O)**, also known as laughing gas, is used as an anesthetic and analgesic.
 
• Each nitrogen compound has distinct properties and uses, making it essential to correctly identify them based on their chemical formulas.
